title: RuleEvidence
description: Aggregates the StrategyAssertion/ChartExample records that support one StrategyRule, so the rule's evidence strength can be judged once rather than re-derived from raw assertions every time the rule is displayed. A rule cannot have modelingStatus 'modeled' without at least one RuleEvidence record with at least one cited assertion or chart example.

supportStrength.description: How strongly this evidence bundle, taken together, supports the rule as currently modeled -- never a substitute for performanceConfidence, which requires real trading data.
